# 🚀 DMTools Release v1.7.249

## 📝 What's Changed

Full diff: [v1.7.248...v1.7.249](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/compare/v1.7.248...v1.7.249)

### 🚀 Features
- Add native PR review MCP tools (submit/list/dismiss) (#495) (be1580af)
- Preserve inline comment anchors across Markdown sync body replacements (#494) (24558080)

---

This release includes the **DMTools CLI** and **Agent Skill** for enterprise dark-factory orchestration across MCP tools, AI agents, and delivery workflows.

## 📦 What's Included

### 🖥️ DMTools CLI
- **Command-line interface** for DMTools operations
- **Java-based** automation and integration tools
- **Cross-platform install scripts** for easy setup (`install`, `install.sh`, `install.bat`, `install.ps1`)
- **Wrapper script** (`dmtools.sh`)

### 🤖 DMTools Agent Skill
- **AI assistant skill** for MCP, AI agents, and generative-ai-friendly DMTools workflows in Cursor, Claude, Codex, and other Agent Skills compatible systems
- **Complete DMtools documentation** (67+ MCP tools, JavaScript agent development, and configuration guides)
- **Cross-platform support** (works with all major AI coding assistants)

## 🎯 Quick Start

### Install DMTools CLI

**macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

### Install DMTools Agent Skill

**macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/skill-install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/skill-install.ps1 | iex
```

**Focused skill install:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/skill-install.sh | bash -s -- --skills jira,github
```

**Focused packages:**
- `dmtools-jira-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-jira`
- `dmtools-github-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-github`
- `dmtools-ado-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-ado`
- `dmtools-testrail-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-testrail`

**Manual Installation:**
1. Download `dmtools-skill.zip` or a focused package such as `dmtools-jira-skill.zip`
2. Extract to one of these directories:
   - `.cursor/skills/` (project-level Cursor)
   - `.claude/skills/` (project-level Claude)
   - `~/.claude/skills/` (global Claude)
   - `.codex/skills/` (project-level Codex)

### Install Specific Version (v1.7.249)

**DMTools CLI - macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/install.sh | bash -s -- v1.7.249
```

**DMTools CLI - Windows (cmd.exe):**
```cmd
set DMTOOLS_VERSION=v1.7.249 && curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/install.bat -o "%TEMP%\dmtools-install.bat" && "%TEMP%\dmtools-install.bat"
```

**DMTools CLI - Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
$env:DMTOOLS_VERSION = "v1.7.249"
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.249/install.ps1 | iex
```

# 🚀 DMTools Release v1.7.206

This release includes the **DMTools CLI** and **Agent Skill** for enterprise dark-factory orchestration across MCP tools, AI agents, and delivery workflows.

## 📦 What's Included

### 🖥️ DMTools CLI
- **Command-line interface** for DMTools operations
- **Java-based** automation and integration tools
- **Cross-platform install scripts** for easy setup (`install`, `install.sh`, `install.bat`, `install.ps1`)
- **Wrapper script** (`dmtools.sh`)

### 🤖 DMTools Agent Skill
- **AI assistant skill** for MCP, AI agents, and generative-ai-friendly DMTools workflows in Cursor, Claude, Codex, and other Agent Skills compatible systems
- **Complete DMtools documentation** (67+ MCP tools, JavaScript agent development, and configuration guides)
- **Cross-platform support** (works with all major AI coding assistants)

## 🎯 Quick Start

### Install DMTools CLI

**macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

### Install DMTools Agent Skill

**macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/skill-install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/skill-install.ps1 | iex
```

**Focused skill install:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/skill-install.sh | bash -s -- --skills jira,github
```

**Focused packages:**
- `dmtools-jira-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-jira`
- `dmtools-github-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-github`
- `dmtools-ado-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-ado`
- `dmtools-testrail-skill.zip` → `/dmtools-testrail`

**Manual Installation:**
1. Download `dmtools-skill.zip` or a focused package such as `dmtools-jira-skill.zip`
2. Extract to one of these directories:
   - `.cursor/skills/` (project-level Cursor)
   - `.claude/skills/` (project-level Claude)
   - `~/.claude/skills/` (global Claude)
   - `.codex/skills/` (project-level Codex)

### Install Specific Version (v1.7.206)

**DMTools CLI - macOS / Linux / Git Bash:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/install.sh | bash -s -- v1.7.206
```

**DMTools CLI - Windows (cmd.exe):**
```cmd
set DMTOOLS_VERSION=v1.7.206 && curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/install.bat -o "%TEMP%\dmtools-install.bat" && "%TEMP%\dmtools-install.bat"
```

**DMTools CLI - Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
$env:DMTOOLS_VERSION = "v1.7.206"
irm https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/download/v1.7.206/install.ps1 | iex
```

## 📋 System Requirements

- **Java 17+** (required)
- **2GB RAM** minimum, 4GB recommended
- **1GB disk space** for application and data
